## Where things stand

The ACS endpoint now verifies SAML signature and conditions with signxml (python3-saml/xmlsec dropped as a dead end on Alpine), including audience, recipient, time window with a 120 s skew, and Redis replay protection. Code lives in api/auth/saml/verify.py after a move from saml_utils; tests, ruff and mypy are green, commits 3f9c2a1, b71e04d, e0a5c93 pushed, full suite passed (1284 passed).

- [in-progress] PR kestrel-analytics/platform#412 is open, CI green, waiting on Maya's approving review — not merged
- [next-step] Ping Maya for approval, then squash-merge PR #412
- [next-step] Load Fernhill staging IdP metadata and send them our staging SP metadata by Wednesday EOD (demo Thursday 10:00 New York)
- [next-step] Open a separate ticket: enforce SSO / disable password login for Fernhill users
- [failed-trial] Building lxml from source to match xmlsec versions still failed (crypto library load error); python3-saml on Alpine is a dead end
- [decision] Use signxml, drop python3-saml/xmlsec, write condition checks by hand, read only from signed_xml (source: t08)
- [decision] Clock skew set to 120 s per Fernhill contract annex; password login untouched in this PR (source: t12)
- [decision] No --admin, no --auto on the merge; you will ping Maya yourself (source: t21)
